dedupe_keys.name: citylearn environment and datasets for building energy coordination and demand response

description: CityLearn is an open-source Gymnasium environment for coordinating building energy use, demand response and reinforcement learning, in which users configure renewable energy communities, run controllers and compare energy, cost and service outcomes. Version 3 combines buildings and thermal systems, PV, batteries, electric vehicles and flexible loads with electrical limits, local energy sharing, changing members and assets, and data or equipment failures; public datasets, such as the 2022 CityLearn Challenge dataset with electric vehicles, are downloaded on first use, and KPIs and a scorecard support comparisons. It is installed with pip, has a web interface, and the latest tags when read were v3.0.x. Coverage: challenge and example datasets for building communities. Access: open package and datasets. Licence: MIT. Caveats: communities are simulated from dataset time series, so results depend on those data and model simplifications. Simulation uses are benchmarking demand response and reinforcement learning controllers for building communities. Related records: BOPTEST test cases.
